title: Tuesday 230801
wodRaw:

title: Wednesday 230802
wodRaw:
[Helen](https://www.crossfit.com/workout/2003/08/09#/comments?utm_source=owned&utm_medium=internal&utm_campaign=crossfit)  

3 rounds for time of:  
Run 400 meters  
21 [kettlebell swings](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-kettlebell-swing)  
12 [pull-ups](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-butterfly-pull-up)

♀ 16-kg KB ♂ 24-kg KB

Record scores to the [CrossFit App](https://qrcodes.pro/HLEFX0).  
Compare [210726](https://www.crossfit.com/210726).

**Scaling:**  
This benchmark workout is an all-out sprint. The swings and pull-ups should be easy enough that you are still able to push the pace on the runs. Intermediate athletes can complete this as prescribed.

**Beginner Option:**  
3 rounds for time of:  
Run **200** meters  
**15** kettlebell swings  
**9 jumping** pull-ups

**♀ 8-kg KB ♂ 12-kg KB**

title: Friday 230804
wodRaw:
Run 5,000 meters for time 

Record scores to the [CrossFit App](https://qrcodes.pro/HLEFX0).    
Compare to [221209](https://www.crossfit.com/221209).
____

title: Saturday 230805
wodRaw:
[Oly Total](https://games.crossfit.com/workouts/games/2023#events-details)

[Snatch](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-snatch) 1-1-1-1-1 reps  
[Clean and jerk](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-clean-and-jerk) 1-1-1-1-1 reps

Record scores to the [CrossFit App](https://qrcodes.pro/HLEFX0).

Compare to [171125](https://www.crossfit.com/workout/2017/11/25#/comments).
____

**Scaling:**  
Experienced athletes should attempt to increase the load every set. Focus on excellent technique and aim for a PR on the 4th or 5th set. Athletes with less experience should consider adding reps, or simply practicing the movement for a set amount of time to develop technique. Watch [The Snatch](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-snatch) and [The Clean and Jerk](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-clean-and-jerk) for a full movement breakdown. 

**Beginner Option:**  
Snatch **3-3-3-3-3 reps**  
Clean and jerk **3-3-3-3-3 reps**

title: Monday 230807
wodRaw:

30 [clean and jerks](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-power-clean-split-jerk) for time

title: Wednesday 230809
wodRaw:
Complete as many rounds as possible in 12 minutes of:  
20 [GHD sit-ups](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-ghd-sit-up)    
10 weighted [pull-ups](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-strict-pull-up) 

♀ 15-lb DB ♂ 25-lb DB 

Post rounds completed to comments.  
***

**Scaling:**  
Despite the volume of GHD sit-ups and the strength required for weighted pull-ups, experienced athletes will still be able to work at a pace that challenges conditioning. Newer athletes might be able to use the GHD but should be cautious about doing too many reps if they blaze through the pulling modifications.

**Intermediate Option**  
Complete as many rounds as possible in 12 minutes of:  
15 GHD sit-ups  
10 weighted pull-ups   

**♀ 10-lb DB ♂ 15-lb DB**

**Beginner Option:**  
Complete as many rounds as possible in 12 minutes of:  
**10** GHD sit-ups, **to parallel**   
10 **assisted** pull-ups

title: Tuesday 230815
wodRaw:
For time:   
21-15-9  
[Deadlifts](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/foundational-movement-deadlift-what-is-a-deadlift#:~:text=The%20deadlift%20is%20one%20of,head%2Dto%2Dtoe%20strength)  
9-7-5  
[Wall walks](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-wall-walk)

♀ 155 lb  ♂ 225 lb   

Post time to [comments](https://www.crossfit.com/230815).  
***  

**Scaling:**  
Reduce the loading to a moderately heavy deadlift for you. An option for a scaled wall walk is to start in a push-up position with the feet touching the wall. Then, move the feet up the wall while keeping the hands in place. Walk the hands 2-4 steps toward the wall. Then, walk the feet and hands back down, without sliding, to a plank, then bring the chest to the ground. 

**Intermediate option:**    
For time:     
21-15-9  
Deadlifts  
9-7-5  
**Scaled** wall walks

**♀ 135 lb  ♂ 205 lb**

**Beginner option:**   
For time:   
21-15-9  
Deadlifts  
9-7-5  
**Bear crawls, 5 ft.**

**♀ 65 lb  ♂ 95 lb**

title: Wednesday 230816

title: Saturday 230819
wodRaw:
[Back squat](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-back-squat) 5-5-5-5-5 reps   
[Front squat](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-front-squat) 3-3-3-3-3 reps  

Score is total load of all sets. 

Post loads and total to [comments](https://www.crossfit.com/230819).  

***  
**Scaling:**  
Experienced athletes can take one of two approaches on today’s workout. 1.  Attempt to increase the load for every set, aiming for a PR on the later sets. Or, 2. Build to approximately 70-80% of your 1-rep-max and maintain consistent working sets. Focus on excellent technique and aim for a PR on the fourth or fifth set. Athletes with less experience should consider a coach’s guidance and drill the mechanics before adding weight.

title: Saturday 230826
wodRaw:
5 rounds of Cindy for time  
5 minutes to establish a heavy [deadlift](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/foundational-movement-deadlift-what-is-a-deadlift#:~:text=The%20deadlift%20is%20one%20of,head%2Dto%2Dtoe%20strength)  
5 rounds of Cindy for time

*One round of Cindy is: 5 [pull-ups](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-kipping-pull-up), 10 [push-ups](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-push-up), and 15 [squats](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-air-squat).   

Post both Cindy splits and deadlift weight to [comments](https://www.crossfit.com/230826). 

**Scaling:**   
If you do not yet have pull-ups, consider scaling the movement to a ring row,  jumping pull-up, or banded pull-up. Beginner-level athletes can work solid mechanics on the deadlift, adding reps to allow more practice. Intermediate athletes can perform this workout as written. 

**Beginner option:**   
5 rounds of modified Cindy for time  
5 minutes to **deadlift 5-5-5-5-5**   
5 rounds of modified Cindy for time  

*One round of **modified** Cindy is: 3 ring rows, 5 assisted push-ups, and 9 squats.

title: Wednesday 230830
wodRaw:

1 [overhead squat](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-overhead-squat)   
10 burpee box jumps   
2 overhead squats   
10 burpee box jumps

10 burpee box jumps

Experienced athletes should choose a weight on the overhead squat that they can pull from the ground and perform at least 10 overhead squat reps when fresh. Newer athletes should significantly reduce the weight. Reduce the height on the box in order to keep pushing the pace. 

**Intermediate option:**
